speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis

The liver function tests show a disproportionate elevation in Alkaline Phosphatase (460 U/L) compared to transaminases, which is highly suggestive of cholestatic liver disease. Given your severe pruritus and the absence of fever or acute infection signs, I am confident this is not pneumonia. Have you noticed any skin rashes or joint pain in your hands?
